# Motion and scenes

Scenes animate nodes on scroll, on load or on interaction. Prefer recipes (`motion.listRecipes`, `motion.applyRecipe`) to hand-written scenes, and read `motion.diagnose` findings after every change.

[`motion.read`](#motionread) · [`motion.replace`](#motionreplace) · [`motion.delete`](#motiondelete) · [`motion.listRecipes`](#motionlistrecipes) · [`motion.applyRecipe`](#motionapplyrecipe) · [`motion.saveRecipe`](#motionsaverecipe) · [`motion.diagnose`](#motiondiagnose)

## motion.read

Read the draft scenes of a page: each scene with its id, trigger, entries and options, as motion.replace writes them. A scene write shares the page tree's revision, and publish copies the scenes with the page.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |

Output: { scenes: ({ id: string (min 1, max 36), pageId: string (min 1, max 36), versionId: string (min 1, max 50), trigger: { type: "scroll", anchor: … \| …, start: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, end?: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, endAnchor?: { nodeId: …, part: …, region?: … },… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}
```

## motion.replace

Replace every scene of a page with `scenes` (at most 500; scene and entry ids unique, each scene's `pageId` the page and `versionId` "_draft"). Each scene is validated against the nodes of the page and of its header and footer: a target none of them holds, or a node id two of them hold (422 scene_target_ambiguous), is refused. For the common effects prefer motion.applyRecipe. A scene write shares the page tree's revision, and publish copies the scenes with the page.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `scenes` | ({ id: string (min 1, max 36), pageId: string (min 1, max 36), versionId: string (min 1, max 50), trigger: { type: "scroll", anchor: { nodeId: …, part?: …, region?: … } \| "viewport", start: { edge: "top" \| "center" \| "bottom", viewport: number ≥0 ≤1, offset?: { value: …, unit: … }, belowHeader?: true }, end?: { edge: "… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","scenes":[]}
```

## motion.delete

Delete one scene of a page by `sceneId` (404 scene_not_found when the page has none with it); the other scenes stay. A scene write shares the page tree's revision, and publish copies the scenes with the page.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `sceneId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","sceneId":"scene-1"}
```

## motion.listRecipes

List the scene recipes a page can apply: the built-in recipes first, then the site's own. Each has a label and a description in Italian and English, and two to four knobs (a number, a choice, a list of words, a node or a distance in screens) with working defaults.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { recipes: ({ id: string, label: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, description: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, source: "built-in" \| "site", knobs: ({ id: …, label: …, help?: …, kind: …, min: …, max: …, step?: …, default: …, unit?: … } \| { id: …, label: …, help?… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## motion.applyRecipe

Build a recipe's scenes on a page from its knobs (a knob left out takes its default; an element knob such as `target` has none and must be given) and replace the page's scenes built by the same recipe on the same target. The scenes carry the recipe meta (`recipe: { id, knobs, custom: false }`) and are validated like motion.replace. The snap recipe writes the page's scroll setting instead, so its batch also needs the `pages` base revision. An unknown recipe is 404 recipe_not_found; refused knobs are 422 recipe_knobs_invalid.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `recipeId` | string | yes |
| `knobs` | Record<string, number \| string (max 200) \| boolean \| string (max 200)[] (≤50) \| { nodeId: string, part?: string (max 50), region?: "header" \| "footer" } \| Record<locale, string (max 200)[] (≤50)>> |  |

Output: { scenes: ({ id: string (min 1, max 36), pageId: string (min 1, max 36), versionId: string (min 1, max 50), trigger: { type: "scroll", anchor: … \| …, start: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, end?: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, endAnchor?: { nodeId: …, part: …, region?: … },… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","recipeId":"dock","knobs":{"target":{"nodeId":"mark0001","part":"root"},"slot":{"nodeId":"logo0001","part":"root","region":"header"},"start":0.95,"duration":0.75}}
```

> Read the recipes and their knobs first (`motion.listRecipes` or the `motion` resource). After applying, the answer's `motion.*` findings name scene problems (hidden-at-rest, overlap...): fix them before finishing.

## motion.saveRecipe

Save scenes of a page that one recipe built as a site recipe (`site:<key>`): the scenes, their source recipe and its knobs, under a label in Italian and English. A site recipe has no knobs of its own; applying it writes its scenes again.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `presets`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `sceneIds` | string (min 1, max 36)[] (≤20) | yes |
| `label` | object | yes |
| `label.it` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `label.en` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `description` | object |  |
| `description.it` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `description.en` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |

Output: { id: string, label: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, description: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, source: "built-in" \| "site", knobs: ({ id: string, label: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, help?: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: … (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","sceneIds":["scene-1"],"label":{"it":"Logo che si aggancia","en":"Docking logo"}}
```

## motion.diagnose

Explain why a page's scenes would not play as authored: one finding per problem, each with a reason code (target-missing, target-ambiguous, stateful-target, overlap, empty-range, hidden-at-rest, never-matches), the scene and the node ref it concerns.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |

Output: { findings: ({ sceneId: string (min 1, max 36), code: "target-missing" \| "target-ambiguous" \| "stateful-target" \| "overlap" \| "empty-range" \| "hidden-at-rest" \| "never-matches", ref?: { nodeId: string, part: string (max 50), region?: "header" \| "footer" }, message: string (min 1, max 500) })[] }

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}
```
